entry.title: Hemingway Classic Natural — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Coffee, aged rum, black tea (projected)
Occasion: Pre-cut relaxed session, afternoon smoke, after a meal
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, toasted wood, coffee, cashew, caramel, black tea and orange peel give the Hemingway Classic a balanced Cameroon profile with more aromatic sweetness than dark weight. The smoke should be smooth and woody with a nutty centre, light spice around the edges and a clean cedar-coffee finish. Its long, narrow perfecto shape keeps it elegant rather than bulky while still giving the blend room to develop.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Arturo Fuente lists the Classic Natural at 7″ × 46; Cigar Hut currently lists the same cigar at 7″ × 48.
practicalLines: Pre-cut before lighting into two 3½″ sessions
